AnyRuleDeclaration.description: Union of all supported rule declarations a policy can contain.

BlocklistRuleDeclaration.description: Declares a rule that rejects passwords containing disallowed strings.

CharPoolRuleDeclaration.description: Declares a rule restricting the total occurrences of characters from specified pools.

CharRuleDeclaration.description: Declares a rule limiting occurrences of specified characters.

ComplexityScore.description:
Discrete complexity score required by a policy.

The higher the value, the stronger (more complex) the password is expected to be. Consumers typically compute a password's complexity (e.g., via zxcvbn or custom heuristics) and compare it against this threshold.

Range: 0 (lowest) to 4 (highest)

HibpRuleDeclaration.description: Declares a rule that queries HIBP to detect compromised passwords.

LengthRuleDeclaration.description: Declares a length rule that validates a password's character count.

OneOfRegexFlags.description: Union of supported RegExp flag string literals.

PolicyDeclaration.description: Declarative description of a password policy.

minComplexity.description: Optional minimum complexity threshold that a password must meet or exceed. If omitted, only the declared rules determine validity. Values: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4

rules.description: The list of rule declarations that passwords must satisfy. See `AnyRuleDeclaration` for supported rule types and their specific configs.

RegexRuleDeclaration.description: Declares a regex-based rule that counts matches of a given pattern.

RuleDeclaration<\"blocklist\",BlocklistC.description:
Base shape of a rule declaration.

TRuleType restricts the `ruleType` discriminator to one of `RuleType`. TSpecificConfig augments the base with the rule's specific configuration.

identifier.description: Optional identifier to distinguish multiple instances of the same rule type.

ruleType.description: Discriminator identifying the concrete rule type.

substringMatch.description: When true, any blocklisted entry appearing as a substring will be rejected.

RuleDeclaration<\"char\",CharConfig>.description:
Base shape of a rule declaration.

TRuleType restricts the `ruleType` discriminator to one of `RuleType`. TSpecificConfig augments the base with the rule's specific configuration.

chars.description: Characters to count within the password.

identifier.description: Optional identifier to distinguish multiple instances of the same rule type.

max.description: Maximum number of occurrences from `chars` allowed.

min.description: Minimum number of occurrences from `chars` required.

ruleType.description: Discriminator identifying the concrete rule type.
